description: This file contains functions and types for loading and processing environment variables in a Next.js project, including reading .env files, expanding variables, and caching loaded environment configurations.

methods.name: processEnv
methods.description: Processes loaded environment files, expands variables, and updates process.env with new variables.

methods.name: loadEnvConfig
methods.description: Loads environment configuration based on the current environment, reading relevant .env files, and caches the result.
